---
title: "研究業績"
lang: ja
---

researchmap に公開している MISC と講演・口頭発表等を一覧表示します。

> 注：researchmap の公開 API から全件を取得しています。researchmap 側で追加・更新した公開業績は、このページにも自動で反映されます。

[researchmap のプロフィール](https://researchmap.jp/uno.tasuku)

## MISC

<div id="misc-list">researchmap から読み込み中...</div>

## 講演・口頭発表等

<div id="presentations-list">researchmap から読み込み中...</div>

<script>
const RM_PERMALINK = "uno.tasuku";
const RM_API = "https://api.researchmap.jp";
const RM_WEB = "https://researchmap.jp";

function langText(value) {
  if (!value) return "";
  if (typeof value === "string") return value;
  return value.ja || value.en || "";
}

function personNames(value) {
  if (!value) return "";
  const people = value.ja || value.en || [];
  return people.map(x => x.name).filter(Boolean).join("、");
}

function escapeHtml(value) {
  return String(value ?? "")
    .replaceAll("&", "&amp;")
    .replaceAll("<", "&lt;")
    .replaceAll(">", "&gt;")
    .replaceAll('"', "&quot;")
    .replaceAll("'", "&#039;");
}

function recordId(item) {
  if (item["rm:id"]) return item["rm:id"];
  if (item["@id"]) return item["@id"].split("/").filter(Boolean).pop();
  return "";
}

function recordUrl(item, type) {
  const id = recordId(item);
  return id ? `${RM_WEB}/${RM_PERMALINK}/${type}/${id}` : `${RM_WEB}/${RM_PERMALINK}`;
}

function uniqueLinks(item, type) {
  const links = [{ label: "researchmap", url: recordUrl(item, type) }];

  const doiList = item?.identifiers?.doi || [];
  doiList.forEach(doi => {
    if (doi) links.push({ label: "DOI", url: `https://doi.org/${doi}` });
  });

  (item.see_also || []).forEach(link => {
    if (!link?.["@id"]) return;
    links.push({
      label: link.label || "関連リンク",
      url: link["@id"]
    });
  });

  const seen = new Set();
  return links.filter(link => {
    if (!link.url || seen.has(link.url)) return false;
    seen.add(link.url);
    return true;
  });
}

function linkHtml(item, type) {
  return uniqueLinks(item, type)
    .map(link => `<a href="${escapeHtml(link.url)}">${escapeHtml(link.label)}</a>`)
    .join(" ／ ");
}

function bibliographicInfo(item) {
  const parts = [];
  if (item.volume) parts.push(`${item.volume}巻`);
  if (item.number) parts.push(`${item.number}号`);
  if (item.starting_page || item.ending_page) {
    const start = item.starting_page || "";
    const end = item.ending_page || "";
    parts.push(start && end ? `${start}–${end}頁` : `${start || end}頁`);
  }
  const publisher = langText(item.publisher);
  if (publisher) parts.push(publisher);
  return parts.join("、");
}

function renderMisc(items) {
  const root = document.getElementById("misc-list");
  if (!items.length) {
    root.textContent = "公開されている MISC はありません。";
    return;
  }

  root.innerHTML = items.map(item => {
    const title = langText(item.paper_title) || "無題";
    const authors = personNames(item.authors);
    const journal = langText(item.publication_name);
    const date = item.publication_date || "";
    const info = bibliographicInfo(item);
    const description = langText(item.description);

    return `
      <section class="research-entry">
        <h3>${escapeHtml(title)}</h3>
        <ul>
          ${authors ? `<li><strong>著者</strong>：${escapeHtml(authors)}</li>` : ""}
          <li><strong>タイトル</strong>：${escapeHtml(title)}</li>
          ${date ? `<li><strong>出版年</strong>：${escapeHtml(date)}</li>` : ""}
          ${journal ? `<li><strong>雑誌・出版物</strong>：${escapeHtml(journal)}</li>` : ""}
          ${info ? `<li><strong>書誌情報</strong>：${escapeHtml(info)}</li>` : ""}
          <li><strong>リンク</strong>：${linkHtml(item, "misc")}</li>
        </ul>
        ${description ? `<h4>概要</h4><p>${escapeHtml(description)}</p>` : ""}
        <hr>
      </section>`;
  }).join("");
}

function renderPresentations(items) {
  const root = document.getElementById("presentations-list");
  if (!items.length) {
    root.textContent = "公開されている講演・口頭発表等はありません。";
    return;
  }

  root.innerHTML = items.map(item => {
    const title = langText(item.presentation_title) || "無題";
    const presenters = personNames(item.presenters);
    const event = langText(item.event);
    const date = item.publication_date || item.from_event_date || "";
    const description = langText(item.description);
    const invited = item.invited === true ? "招待講演" : "";

    return `
      <section class="research-entry">
        <h3>${escapeHtml(title)}</h3>
        <ul>
          ${presenters ? `<li><strong>発表者</strong>：${escapeHtml(presenters)}</li>` : ""}
          <li><strong>タイトル</strong>：${escapeHtml(title)}</li>
          ${date ? `<li><strong>発表日</strong>：${escapeHtml(date)}</li>` : ""}
          ${event ? `<li><strong>学会・研究会</strong>：${escapeHtml(event)}</li>` : ""}
          ${invited ? `<li><strong>区分</strong>：${invited}</li>` : ""}
          <li><strong>リンク</strong>：${linkHtml(item, "presentations")}</li>
        </ul>
        ${description ? `<h4>概要</h4><p>${escapeHtml(description)}</p>` : ""}
        <hr>
      </section>`;
  }).join("");
}

async function loadResearchmap(type, renderer) {
  const url = `${RM_API}/${RM_PERMALINK}/${type}?limit=1000&format=json`;
  try {
    const response = await fetch(url, {
      headers: { "Accept": "application/json" }
    });
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
    const data = await response.json();
    const items = Array.isArray(data.items) ? data.items : [];
    renderer(items);
  } catch (error) {
    const rootId = type === "misc" ? "misc-list" : "presentations-list";
    document.getElementById(rootId).innerHTML =
      `researchmap からの取得に失敗しました。<a href="${RM_WEB}/${RM_PERMALINK}">researchmap で確認</a>`;
    console.error(error);
  }
}

loadResearchmap("misc", renderMisc);
loadResearchmap("presentations", renderPresentations);
</script>
